other_conditions: Village must have Scheduled Caste population greater than 50% of its total population
Village total population must be greater than 500
Eligibility applies to villages across 25 States & UTs
Selection is made in descending order of SC population
benefits_summary: Provides comprehensive infrastructure and social development support to SC‑majority villages, covering roads, water, electricity, housing, sanitation, education, health, livelihood and community facilities.
